no_gpu.message: Enable Docker Model Runner in Docker Desktop Settings > AI, then enable host-side TCP access to use the model from Copilot. On Linux, install docker-model-plugin and run docker model install-runner. The hub reconnects automatically. NVIDIA hosts can also use the NVIDIA container runtime.

no_docker.message: The hub cannot reach Docker. Check that Docker is running and /var/run/docker.sock is mounted. Browsing and downloads remain available.
